intent: A pale quarry-stone set caked in dust white, cut in square blocks under a stepped dark slate helm, its pauldrons still holding the quarryman's iron wedges and a bone skull hung at the left hip, so from the high camera it reads as a pale-bodied, dark-headed stone warden.
requests: A matte stone/slate material that takes a pale grey tint, so the pale plates read as cut quarry stone up close as well as at distance; Metal was the closest plain material available.
